summary: No installer-harm signals identified in pp-react-ui5@21.0.0
details: Analysis of pp-react-ui5@21.0.0 (4 files) surfaced no behaviors matching supply-chain attack classes: no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.npmrc, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, browser profiles), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no backdoor or silent-relay mechanisms observed. The package appears benign under the criteria evaluated here.
